name: Asahi Kogyosha Co., Ltd.
summary: Asahi Kogyosha Co., Ltd. primarily engaged in the design, supervision, and construction of air conditioning and sanitary equipment in Japan. The company operates through the Equipment Installation Business; and Equipment Manufacturing and Sales Business segments. It also develops, designs, and manufactures precision environmental control equipment for industries involved in manufacturing semiconductors and liquid crystal panels. The company was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
